messages:
Alex (sales): Hey team — NovumBank just asked for our compliance pack to move from evaluation -> contract. They want SOC2 artifacts, a pen-test letter, and a short statement about on-prem options. Can we assemble and estimate turnaround?
Devon (solutions): I can pull the SOC2/ISO artifacts we have and the architecture diagram. Need to confirm scope (prod vs sandbox). @Tom can you confirm what they need scoped?
Tom (acct exec): Novum asked for ‘production service scope’ only. They also asked whether using Redwood Private (VPC) changes pricing. Quick answer: yes it’s a separate line item — I’ll send estimated uplift but need exact node counts.
Alex (sales): Good — they specifically listed: SOC2 Type II report, ISO27001 cert (if available), signed pen-test letter, audit logs retention statement, KMS/HSM attestation. Also asked for an NDA-addendum for sharing raw logs.
Devon (solutions): Copying the checklist into the thread so we don't miss anything:
```
- SOC2 Type II (latest) - scope: production
- ISO27001 cert (if available)
- Signed pen-test vendor letter (we provide template)
- KMS/HSM integration statement and diagram
- Data flow diagram (PII/processes)
- Audit logs retention & access policy (SaaS vs Private differences)
- On-prem packaging / air-gap statement (if requested)
- Contact for audit artifacts delivery (SRE/Compliance mailbox)
```
Mouna (security): I can draft the pen-test letter template and the KMS attestation. For the signed pen-test letter we need engagement from our external pen-test vendor — typically 3-5 business days to issue an attestation after we request it. If customer needs a vendor-signed letter (vs our internal attestation), that adds time/cost.
Ellen (legal): For the NDA-addendum, we have a standard audit access addendum that I can attach. If they want raw logs shipped, we'll require a Data Processing Addendum update and a scoping call.
Tom (acct exec): Pricing note: Redwood Private (VPC) + on-prem packaging will add a one-time deployment fee and higher monthly platform fee. I estimate ~20-30% uplift on committed capacity line for VPC, depends on GPU sku and region. I'll get a precise quote once Devon confirms node counts.
Alex (sales): Devon — can you drop the drive folder link with the artifacts you already have? I'll forward to the customer and Ellen.
Devon (solutions): Link: https://drive.internal/redwood/compliance/NovumBank-req-1797 (internal only) — contains our SOC2 package, the last ISO certificate scan, and the network diagram. Missing: signed pen-test letter, updated KMS diagram for their region.
Mouna (security): I'll request the pen-test vendor attestation today. @sec-bot can you create a ticket for external vendor request?
sec-bot: Ticket created: #SEC-4491 — vendor attestation request for NovumBank. ETA vendor response 3-5 business days.
Ellen (legal): Sending NDA addendum now, attaching comment about logs export obligations and retention.
Tom (acct exec): Customer asked if we can provide a short cover note summarizing what’s in the pack and any known gaps — Alex, can you draft? They want it by EOD tomorrow to share with procurement.
Alex (sales): Will do. Draft outline: what we include, what requires separate request (vendor letter), timelines (pen-test: 3-5bd, on-prem packaging: 2-3 weeks), pricing note about VPC uplift, contact points. Posting draft in ~3 hours. :thumbsup:
Devon (solutions): FYI — to generate the logs export statement I need to confirm retention windows per environment. @Mouna can you confirm Prod retention is 90 days by default and archival options available?
Mouna (security): Yes, Prod default is 90 days, 1 year archival on request (longer retention requires private deployment or add-on). I'll write that into the policy snippet.
Alex (sales): Perfect — thanks all. If anything urgent ping me. I'll attach the draft cover note + Ellen's NDA addendum when ready.
Tom (acct exec): Thanks team. NovumBank is target for this quarter so let's prioritize.
Devon (solutions): Uploading revised KMS diagram and a short README into the drive in ~1 hour.
Ellen (legal): Uploaded NDA-addendum to the thread and added signature instructions.
Mouna (security): Pen-test vendor updated SEC-4491 with estimated delivery 72 hours. Noted: if they request a re-run scoped to customer-specific integrations that's a separate engagement.
Alex (sales): Got it — I'll flag that in the cover note as an optional paid add-on. Closing loop after I send to Novum. :pray:
